Who I Am

About Me

I'm Marvin Canonigo, a General Virtual Assistant & Automation Specialist based in Davao City, Philippines, with over 5 years of experience helping businesses run smarter, faster, and with less manual effort.

I don't just handle tasks — I build systems. From architecting high-performance GoHighLevel CRM ecosystems to connecting apps through Make.com and n8n, I turn repetitive workflows into fully automated pipelines that run while you sleep.

One of my standout capabilities is building fully functional websites and web tools using AI — including custom CRMs, shift reporting systems, lead trackers, and client management dashboards — all coded with Claude and deployed live on the web. No template. No agency. Just smart, clean, purpose-built tools.

On the admin side, I'm highly experienced in day-to-day virtual assistance — calendar management, data entry, inbox handling, file organization, report generation, appointment scheduling, and keeping operations tight so nothing falls through the cracks.

Common Questions

FAQ

► What's your availability?

I'm available for full-time roles, project contracts, and retainers. I work during CET & Philippines business hours. Response time is same-day for inquiries.

► How long do projects take?

Depends on scope. Simple automations: 1–2 weeks. Full GHL setups: 2–4 weeks. Custom web tools: 1–3 weeks. We agree on timeline upfront.

► Do you offer free consultations?

Yes. Let's chat about your project — I'll ask questions, understand your goals, and tell you if I'm the right fit. No pressure, no sales pitch. Just a conversation.

► What if I need someone part-time?

Absolutely. I do part-time VA work, hourly contracts, and hybrid arrangements. We can customize something that fits your budget and needs. Let's discuss.

► Can you work in my timezone?

I'm in Davao City (UTC+8). I'm flexible with hours and can overlap most international timezones for sync meetings. Async communication works great too.

► How do I get started?

Hit me up via WhatsApp, email, or phone. Tell me about your project. I'll ask questions, scope it out, send a proposal, and we'll go from there. Simple.
